name: Kittiwake Bank - CR-07 section 5 early arrears outbound calls (v4.2 + email 07/10/2026 + CPN-2026-019)

id_phone_last4.description: the last four digits of the customer's phone number, given as the answer to the security question

id_date_of_birth.description: the customer's date of birth, given as the answer to the security question

promise_date.description: the day the customer says they can pay

promise_amount.description: an amount of money the customer says they can pay

next_weekday.description: the weekday the customer named with the word 'next' in front of it (as in 'next Friday'); empty when they did not say 'next' with a weekday

which_option.description: which of the two dates the agent just named the customer chose: the earlier one (first) or the later one (second)

product_ref.description: which of the customer's products they are talking about, as said (e.g. 'the car loan', 'the card ending 4821')

callback_date.description: the day on which the customer can be reached

callback_time.description: the time of day at which the customer can be reached

intents.description: says they ARE in a breathing space under the Debt Respite Scheme (a standard breathing space or a mental health crisis breathing space), even if they also mention a debt adviser (not: only about to apply for a breathing space)
says the customer has died
says this number does not belong to the customer / no such person at this number

says they are getting help from a debt adviser (for example StepChange, Citizens Advice, National Debtline or a MoneyHelper adviser), or that they are about to apply for a breathing space (not: already in a breathing space)

tells about a physical or mental health condition, a disability, a serious illness, a bereavement, caring for someone, an addiction or domestic abuse, or says they find the call hard to understand (not: loss of a job or income, which is hardship)

says they have lost their job or their income, that their income has fallen, that they cannot afford the minimum payment or instalment offered, or asks for a payment plan or lower monthly payments (not: only saying the full arrears amount is too much; not: a discount, refund, waiver or interest freeze)
asks to be put through to a person, a human or an adviser (not: asking whether the agent is a person)
says 'yes', 'speaking', 'that's me', or gives the customer's name as their own (not: 'Hello?', 'Who is this?', 'What's it about?')
says the customer is not there or not available, or that they are someone else such as a family member (not: the number does not belong to the customer; not: the customer has died)
someone other than the customer offers to pay, to pass on a message, or to answer the security questions for the customer
says they have already paid this product's arrears (the past-due amount) (not: a part of it; not: the account was closed or paid off in the past, which is a dispute)
'This isn't mine', 'I never had this', 'I closed that account', or says the account was closed or paid off in the past
asks for a discount, a refund or waiver of fees or interest, an interest freeze or token payments (not: a payment plan or lower monthly payments, which is hardship)
asks to change or cancel a promise already made in this call
says they do not want to talk / do not want this call at all (not: declining one offer or one question)
cannot or will not say when the customer can be reached
says the full arrears AMOUNT is too much or more than they can pay (not: cannot pay today or on that day, which is about the day; not: naming a smaller amount; not: lost job or income)
says no to paying at all / will not pay, with no date and no amount (not: only 'not today'; not: cannot afford it or lost income)
gives only a vague time instead of a day ('next week', 'end of the month', 'when I get paid') (not: a weekday or a date)
asks whether the agent is a robot, an AI or a real person
asks whether this call is a scam or genuinely from the bank
asks what the call is about or why we are calling
refuses to answer the question asked
asks a question the agent cannot answer from the account details (e.g. interest, fees, balances, what a plan would cost)
says yes / agrees to what the agent just asked or offered
says no to what the agent just asked or offered

opening.text: Hello, this is Kittiwake Bank's digital assistant. We record this call.

reason_pre.text: I'm Kittiwake Bank's digital assistant, and I can only discuss the reason for my call with {call.first_name} {call.last_name}.

tp_ask_when.text: When would be a good time to reach {call.first_name} {call.last_name}?

tp_only_customer.text: Thank you, but I can only speak to {call.first_name} {call.last_name}.

tp_reason.text: I'm sorry, I can only discuss that with {call.first_name} {call.last_name}.

cb_invalid.text: I'm sorry, I can't book a call back then. Could you give me another day and time?

cb_booked.text: Thank you. We will call back on {day_label(var.cb_date)} at {var.cb_time}.

cb_failed.text: I'm sorry, I couldn't book that call back.

sorry_loss.text: I'm very sorry for your loss.

goodbye.text: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

ask_phone.text: Before we go on, I need to ask you two security questions. First, what are the last four digits of the phone number we hold for you?

ask_phone_again.text: Could you give me the last four digits of the phone number we hold for you, please?

ask_dob.text: Thank you. Now, what is your date of birth?

ask_dob_again.text: Could you give me your date of birth, please?

ask_month_word.text: Could you say your date of birth again, with the month as a word, for example 5 December?

wrong_answer.text: I'm sorry, that doesn't match our records.

id_failed.text: I'm sorry, I can't go any further with this call. Please call the Bank on the number on our website or on any letter or statement from us, or visit a branch.

id_protect.text: These questions are there to protect your account. I can only continue once you've answered them.

bs_security_first.text: I need to finish the security questions first so that the right account is updated.

arrears_intro.text: I'm calling from Kittiwake Bank's Arrears Support team about missed payments.

product_line.text: Your {item.label} is £{money(item.past_due)} in arrears and has been in arrears for {item.days_late} days.

nosia.text: You will also receive a letter called a Notice of Sums in Arrears, with an information sheet from the Financial Conduct Authority.

ask_today.text: Can you pay the full arrears of £{money(item.past_due)} today?

ask_all_today.text: Can you pay the full arrears on all of them today, £{money(var.total)} in total?

ask_by_date.text: By what date can you pay the full arrears of £{money(item.past_due)} on your {item.label}?

ask_date_for_amt.text: By what date can you pay £{money(item.amt)} on your {item.label}?

ask_exact_date.text: Could you give me an exact date for your {item.label}?

credit_ref.text: Anything left unpaid stays in arrears and may be reported to credit reference agencies.

floor_offer.text: Could you pay the {item.fname} of £{money(item.floor)} on your {item.label}{when_words(var.pend_date)} instead?

below_floor_offer.text: I'm sorry, I can't record an amount below the {item.fname} of £{money(item.floor)}. Could you pay the {item.fname} of £{money(item.floor)}{when_words(var.pend_date)}?

below_floor_no.text: I'm sorry, I can't record an amount below the {item.fname} of £{money(item.floor)}.

past_date.text: I'm sorry, I can only take a date from today onwards.

latest_offer.text: The latest date I can record for your {item.label} is {day_label(item.latest)}. Could you pay {amt_words(item.amt, item.past_due, item.floor, item.fname)} by {day_label(item.latest)}?

propose_latest.text: Could you pay {amt_words(item.amt, item.past_due, item.floor, item.fname)} on your {item.label} by {day_label(item.latest)}?

alt_offer.text: {day_label(var.cand)} is not a banking day. Could you pay {amt_words(item.amt, item.past_due, item.floor, item.fname)} on {day_label(var.offer_date)} instead?

alt_all_offer.text: {day_label(var.cand)} is not a banking day. Could you pay on {day_label(var.offer_date)} instead?

persuasion.text: Could you pay the {item.fname} of £{money(item.floor)} on your {item.label} by {day_label(item.latest)}?

ask_change.text: What would you like to change?

ask_which_product.text: Which product would you like to change, and what is the new amount?

trying_again.text: Sorry, something went wrong. I'm trying again.

promise_recorded.text: Your promise for your {item.label} is recorded.

not_recorded.text: I'm sorry, I could not record the promise for your {item.label}.

letter.text: We will send you a letter confirming your promise to pay.

moneyhelper.text: Free, impartial debt advice is available from MoneyHelper.

review_offer.text: The Financial Support team can go through your income and outgoings with you and look at the options. Would you like me to transfer you to them now?

vuln_offer.text: The Bank wants to make sure you get the right support. Would you like me to transfer you to our Specialist Support team?

transfer_goodbye.text: Thank you. I'm transferring you now. Goodbye.

human_help.text: I may be able to help you with that myself. Would you like me to try first?

bot.text: I'm Kittiwake Bank's automated digital assistant.

scam.text: You can hang up and call the Bank on the number on our website or on any letter or statement from us.

no_info.text: I'm sorry, I don't have that information.

no_concession.text: I'm sorry, I can't agree that.

change_recorded.text: I can't change that promise in this call. You can call the Bank on the number on our website or on any letter or statement from us.

bs_post.text: Thank you for telling me. We will pause collection on your accounts and will not ask you for any payment during the breathing space.

debt_advice.text: We will put collection on hold for 30 days to give you time to get advice.

paid_ack.text: Thank you. Payments can take up to two banking days to show.

dispute_ack.text: Thank you for letting me know. I won't ask you for a payment on that.

service_problem.text: I'm sorry, I can't get the details I need right now.

latest_date.expr: prev_business_day(add_days(today, 14), True) if dl <= 14 else (add_business_days(today, 7) if dl <= 30 else add_business_days(today, 3))

label_of.expr: 'credit card ending ' + str_(l4) if t == 'credit_card' else ('personal loan' if t == 'personal_loan' else 'car finance agreement')

amt_words.expr: 'the full arrears of £' + money(pd) if a == pd else ('the ' + fname + ' of £' + money(fl) if a == fl else '£' + money(a))

when_words.expr: ((' today' if d == today else ' by ' + day_label(d)) if is_set(d) else '')

cap_note.expr: ', which is the latest date I can record for it' if c else ''

rank_idx.expr: 0 if r0 == r else (1 if r1 == r else 2)

next_after.expr: add_days(d, 1) if lower(n) in lower(day_label(add_days(d, 1))) else (add_days(d, 2) if lower(n) in lower(day_label(add_days(d, 2))) else (add_days(d, 3) if lower(n) in lower(day_label(add_days(d, 3))) else (add_days(d, 4) if lower(n) in lower(day_label(add_days(d, 4))) else (add_days(d, 5) if lower(n) in lower(day_label(add_days(d, 5))) else (add_days(d, 6) if lower(n) in lower(day_label(add_days(d, 6))) else add_days(d, 7))))))

cb_ok.expr: date_ge(d, today) and date_le(d, add_days(today, 7)) and (d != today or t > nt) and not (is_holiday(d) and d != '2026-10-23') and not ('sunday' in lower(day_label(d))) and ((date_ge(d, '2026-10-24') and time_in_window(t, '09:00', '13:00')) if 'saturday' in lower(day_label(d)) else time_in_window(t, '08:00', '20:00'))

set.var.offer_date: item.latest if date_lt(item.latest, next_business_day(var.cand)) else next_business_day(var.cand)

set.var.cand: var.in_date if is_set(var.in_date) else (var.offer_date if (var.q == 'alt_date' or var.q == 'latest' or var.q == 'persuasion') else (var.pend_date if var.q == 'floor' else (item.prev_date if flag.changing else None)))

set.item.ok_date: item.latest if date_lt(item.latest, var.cand) else var.cand

set.item.rank: (1 if var.d0 > item.days_late else 0) + (1 if var.d1 > item.days_late else 0) + (1 if var.d2 > item.days_late else 0) + (1 if (var.d0 == item.days_late and item.idx > 0) else 0) + (1 if (var.d1 == item.days_late and item.idx > 1) else 0)

set.var.cand: slot.promise_date if is_set(slot.promise_date) else (var.nwd_a if slot.which_option == 'first' else var.nwd_b)

set.var.in_date: slot.promise_date if is_set(slot.promise_date) else (var.nwd_a if slot.which_option == 'first' else var.nwd_b)

do.if: not item.floor_offered and var.q != 'persuasion' and var.q != 'floor'

set.var.pend_date: today if var.q == 'today' else (var.offer_date if (var.q == 'alt_date' or var.q == 'latest') else None)

for_each_item.if: item.outcome != 'paid' and item.outcome != 'promise' and item.rank < var.best

close.outcome: 'promise' if flag.promise_recorded else ('paid' if count_where(items, 'outcome', 'paid') == var.n else 'no_promise')
close.reason: None if (flag.promise_recorded or count_where(items, 'outcome', 'paid') == var.n) else var.first_reason

ambiguities.question: amendment
ambiguities.decision: Stage 1 latest promise date: old 21 calendar days after today, new 14 calendar days after today (last banking day before it if needed). Only the new value is built.
ambiguities.why: CPN-2026-019 item 1 applies to every call from 14/10/2026, the go-live date of the assistant.

ambiguities.question: amendment
ambiguities.decision: Old: banking days = Mon-Fri except Table 5.2. New: 23/10/2026 is also a non-banking day for promises (in calendar.holidays); callbacks ignore it (cb_ok excludes 2026-10-23 from the holiday test).
ambiguities.why: CPN item 2; callbacks are explicitly unaffected.

ambiguities.question: amendment
ambiguities.decision: Old: 'next <weekday>' = that weekday in the following Monday-Sunday week. New: ask 'Do you mean <first such day after today> or <one week later>?' and use the answer as the date, then the normal checks. Applied to promise dates only.
ambiguities.why: Email of 07/10/2026 is the instruction until v4.3; 5.7.7 is about promise dates.

ambiguities.question: amendment
ambiguities.decision: Old 5.13: transfer to queue support, close transferred / breathing_space_referral (R13). New 5.13: say the pause script, no transfer, record nothing more, close no_promise / breathing_space (R20); before the checks say the security questions must be finished first.
ambiguities.why: CPN item 3 replaces 5.13 and retires R13 from 14/10/2026.

ambiguities.question: amendment
ambiguities.decision: Old: no Saturday callbacks. New: Saturdays on or after 24/10/2026, 09:00-13:00 inclusive; 7-day limit and weekday hours unchanged.
ambiguities.why: CPN item 4; the email said not to build it from the thread.

ambiguities.question: amendment
ambiguities.decision: Old: never offer or agree a refund/waiver. New: never offer, mention or agree any refund, waiver or reduction of fees or interest; the fee-refund proposal is not built. Encoded as restricted words never allowed.

ambiguities.question: The tool says three wrong answers end the check; the policy says two.
ambiguities.decision: Two wrong answers in total end the checks (counter.wrong), regardless of wrong_answers_left.

ambiguities.question: How to encode 'this <weekday>' / bare weekday ('first such day on or after today').
ambiguities.why: Closest available encoding of 'the coming Friday'.

ambiguities.question: After a declined review or Specialist Support offer, does the call continue?
ambiguities.decision: The pending payment question is asked again; persuasion is replaced by noting the product hardship.
ambiguities.why: 5.12(d) says continue the call; 5.11(e) is parallel.

ambiguities.question: Does 5.12 apply before the security checks?
ambiguities.decision: Handled only after the checks have passed.
ambiguities.why: Narrowest reading; the transfer and the hardship notes are account actions.

ambiguities.question: An 'already paid' or dispute claim with no product named at the all-products question.
ambiguities.why: The question was about all of them.

ambiguities.question: get_account fails.
ambiguities.decision: Say the details are not available, say goodbye and close as no_promise / service_error.
ambiguities.why: The spec is silent; service_error is the code for a technical failure.

amendments.old: 'Next <weekday>' means that weekday in the following week (Monday to Sunday).
amendments.new: Ask which date they mean, naming the next such weekday after today and the same weekday one week later; the customer's answer is the date, then the normal checks apply.
amendments.scope: 5.7.7 last sentence only; the first sentence is unchanged

amendments.old: Never offer or agree a refund/waiver of fees or interest
amendments.new: Must not even mention any refund, waiver or reduction of fees or interest, whatever or whenever the customer pays
23/10/2026 is a non-banking day for promises and for latest-promise-date counting

amendments.old: transfer to queue support, close transferred / breathing_space_referral
amendments.new: say the pause script, no transfer, record nothing more, close no_promise / breathing_space; before the checks, finish security first

amendments.effective: Saturdays from 24/10/2026 (bookable from 14/10 within the 7-day window)

ambiguities_seen.question: The verify_identity tool summary says three wrong answers end the check; the policy says two.
readings: Follow the policy: end the checks after 2 wrong answers, regardless of wrong_answers_left.

ambiguities_seen.question: With the new 'next <weekday>' rule, if today is that weekday, is 'the next such day after today' today+7 (and the alternative today+14)?
Can a Saturday 24/10/2026 callback be booked on a call made before 14/10/2026 (item 4 has its own effective rule)?
readings: Yes; the only condition is that the Saturday is on or after 24/10 and within 7 days.

ambiguities_seen.question: With multiple products, some paid and some disputed or refused, the outcome is no_promise with the first non-paid note reason.
Does 'about to apply for a breathing space' still fall under 5.14 after the CPN?
readings: Yes; only being in a breathing space triggers new 5.13.
